maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from billing/CRM software, new platform implementations and managed services for telecom carriers, not repair or aftermarket replacement.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private telecom, media and financial companies such as AT&T, Telefónica, VEON and PLDT.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own software and services business and large telco contracts, with only occasional acquisitions like Matrixx.

mission_critical.reason: Core billing, charging, CRM and network operations systems for carriers are deeply embedded; switching means costly migration and downtime.
